require 'socket'
require 'timeout'
require 'thread'

module DNSResolver
  class CircuitBreaker
    STATES = [:closed, :open, :half_open].freeze
    
    attr_reader :state, :failure_count, :last_failure_time
    
    def initialize(failure_threshold: 5, recovery_timeout: 30)
      @failure_threshold = failure_threshold
      @recovery_timeout = recovery_timeout
      @failure_count = 0
      @state = :closed
      @last_failure_time = nil
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end
    
    def call(&block)
      case @state
      when :open
        if Time.now - @last_failure_time >= @recovery_timeout
          try_half_open(&block)
        else
          raise CircuitOpenError, "Circuit breaker is open"
        end
      when :half_open
        try_half_open(&block)
      when :closed
        try_request(&block)
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def try_request(&block)
      result = block.call
      @mutex.synchronize { @failure_count = 0 }
      result
    rescue => e
      record_failure
      raise e
    end
    
    def try_half_open(&block)
      result = block.call
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @state = :closed
        @failure_count = 0
      end
      result
    rescue => e
      @mutex.synchronize { @state = :open }
      @last_failure_time = Time.now
      raise e
    end
    
    def record_failure
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @failure_count += 1
        if @failure_count >= @failure_threshold
          @state = :open
          @last_failure_time = Time.now
        end
      end
    end
  end

  class RateLimiter
    def initialize(max_requests:, window_seconds:)
      @max_requests = max_requests
      @window_seconds = window_seconds
      @requests = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end
    
    def allow?(client_id)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        cleanup_expired_entries
        @requests[client_id] ||= []
        current_window_start = window_start(Time.now)
        
        # Count requests in current window
        active_requests = @requests[client_id].select do |timestamp|
          timestamp >= current_window_start
        end
        @requests[client_id] = active_requests
        
        if active_requests.length < @max_requests
          @requests[client_id] << Time.now
          true
        else
          false
        end
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def window_start(time)
      # Align to window boundary using integer division
      epoch = time.to_i
      aligned = (epoch / @window_seconds) * @window_seconds
      Time.at(aligned)
    end
    
    def cleanup_expired_entries
      cutoff = Time.now - (@window_seconds * 2)
      @requests.delete_if { |_, timestamps| timestamps.all? { |t| t < cutoff } }
    end
  end

  class Resolver
    def initialize(upstream_dns: '8.8.8.8', port: 53, max_rps: 10, window: 60)
      @upstream_dns = upstream_dns
      @port = port
      @circuit_breaker = CircuitBreaker.new(failure_threshold: 3, recovery_timeout: 60)
      @rate_limiter = RateLimiter.new(max_requests: max_rps, window_seconds: window)
      @cache = {}
      @cache_mutex = Mutex.new
    end
    
    def resolve(domain, client_id:, query_type: :A)
      # Normalize the domain for cache lookup
      normalized = normalize_domain(domain)
      
      # Check cache first - cache hits don't count against rate limit
      cached = lookup_cache(normalized, query_type)
      return cached if cached
      
      # Apply rate limiting
      unless @rate_limiter.allow?(client_id)
        raise RateLimitExceeded, "Rate limit exceeded for client #{client_id}"
      end
      
      # Use circuit breaker for upstream query
      result = @circuit_breaker.call do
        perform_dns_query(normalized, query_type)
      end
      
      # Cache the result
      store_cache(normalized, query_type, result)
      result
    end
    
    private
    
    def normalize_domain(domain)
      # Strip trailing dot, downcase, handle IDN
      d = domain.to_s.strip.downcase
      d = d.chomp('.')
      # Collapse multiple dots
      d.gsub(/\.{2,}/, '.')
    end
    
    def lookup_cache(domain, query_type)
      @cache_mutex.synchronize do
        key = cache_key(domain, query_type)
        entry = @cache[key]
        return nil unless entry
        if Time.now - entry[:stored_at] > entry[:ttl]
          @cache.delete(key)
          return nil
        end
        entry[:result]
      end
    end
    
    def store_cache(domain, query_type, result)
      @cache_mutex.synchronize do
        key = cache_key(domain, query_type)
        @cache[key] = { result: result, stored_at: Time.now, ttl: 300 }
      end
    end
    
    def cache_key(domain, query_type)
      "#{domain}:#{query_type}"
    end
    
    def perform_dns_query(domain, query_type)
      Timeout.timeout(5) do
        socket = UDPSocket.new
        begin
          packet = build_query_packet(domain, query_type)
          socket.send(packet, 0, @upstream_dns, @port)
          response, _ = socket.recvfrom(512)
          parse_response(response)
        ensure
          socket.close
        end
      end
    rescue Timeout::Error
      raise ResolverTimeout, "DNS query timed out for #{domain}"
    end
    
    def build_query_packet(domain, query_type)
      # Simplified DNS query packet construction
      id = rand(0xFFFF)
      flags = 0x0100 # Standard query with recursion desired
      header = [id, flags, 1, 0, 0, 0].pack('nnnnnn')
      
      qname = domain.split('.').map { |label| [label.length].pack('C') + label }.join + "\x00"
      qtype = query_type == :A ? 1 : 28  # A or AAAA
      qclass = 1  # IN
      question = qname + [qtype, qclass].pack('nn')
      
      header + question
    end
    
    def parse_response(data)
      # Simplified response parsing - return IP addresses
      return nil if data.nil? || data.length < 12
      answer_count = data[6..7].unpack('n')[0]
      return nil if answer_count == 0
      data  # Return raw for simplicity
    end
  end

  class CircuitOpenError < StandardError; end
  class RateLimitExceeded < StandardError; end
  class ResolverTimeout < StandardError; end
end
